content: Sphinx 9.1.0 (2025-12-31, needs Python 3.12+). MyST-Parser 5.1.0 (2026-05). MyST (CommonMark + Sphinx roles/directives via colon_fence) is the 2026 default recommendation for new docs-as-code: full rST power with Markdown ergonomics; Sphinx reads .md and .rst side-by-side. furo theme (2025.12.19 calver), sphinx-design (2026-01) for components. Read the Docs officially endorses Diataxis (tutorials/how-to/reference/explanation) one-category-per-page navigation. For an AI drafting layer, MyST is easier for models to emit reliably than rST.
